# The Garage Guide

> Independent guide to garage doors, floor coatings, organization, EV chargers, insulation, and heating for homeowners.

The Garage Guide is an independent home-services publication covering garage doors and openers, floor coatings (epoxy and polyaspartic), storage systems, EV charger installation, insulation, ventilation, heating, and workshop setup. Cost guides are updated for 2026 with regional pricing, product reviews are based on hands-on evaluation, and problem guides walk homeowners through diagnosis and repair. Free installation and repair quotes are available through partner Networx.

## Problem Diagnosis & Repair

- [Cracked Garage Floor: When to Worry, How to Fix It, and What It Costs](https://thegarage.guide/problems/cracked-garage-floor): Every concrete garage floor cracks eventually. Learn which cracks are cosmetic vs structural, DIY repair steps, and when to resurface or replace. Fix costs from $5 to $7,000.
- [Garage Door Cable Broke: Causes, What to Do Right Now, and Repair Costs](https://thegarage.guide/problems/garage-door-cable-broke): Garage door cable broke? Find out what caused it, what to do right now, whether you can fix it yourself, and what professional repair costs in 2026.
- [Garage Door Keypad Not Working? Troubleshooting Guide 2026](https://thegarage.guide/problems/garage-door-keypad-not-working): Garage door keypad not responding? Diagnose and fix the 10 most common keypad problems in 5 minutes. Step-by-step guide for Chamberlain, LiftMaster, Genie, and universal keypads.
- [Garage Door Making Noise? Diagnose the Sound and Fix It](https://thegarage.guide/problems/garage-door-makes-noise): Garage door making noise? Diagnose grinding, squeaking, banging, rattling, and popping sounds by component. Fixes for each noise type and when to call a pro.
- [Garage Door Off Track: Causes, How to Fix It, and When to Call a Pro](https://thegarage.guide/problems/garage-door-off-track): Garage door off track? Diagnose the cause, fix minor derailments safely, and know when to call a pro. Covers bent tracks, broken cables, worn rollers, and repair costs.
- [Garage Door Opener Not Working? Troubleshooting Guide](https://thegarage.guide/problems/garage-door-opener-not-working): Diagnose and fix common garage door opener problems including remote failures, sensor issues, grinding noises, and doors that reverse. Step-by-step troubleshooting with cost estimates.
- [Garage Door Opens By Itself: Causes, Fixes, and How to Stop It](https://thegarage.guide/problems/garage-door-opens-by-itself): Garage door opener opens by itself? Diagnose the exact cause — stuck button, frequency interference, wiring short, bad logic board, or sensor issue — and fix it step by step.
- [Garage Door Spring Replacement: Cost, Signs, and What to Expect](https://thegarage.guide/problems/garage-door-spring-replacement): Garage door spring replacement costs $150 to $350 professionally. Learn the signs your spring is failing, what type you have, and why this is never a DIY repair.
- [Garage Door Weather Stripping: When to Replace It and How to Do It Right](https://thegarage.guide/problems/garage-door-weather-stripping): Garage door weather stripping replacement guide. Signs it has failed, which of the 4 seals to replace, costs, and step-by-step DIY installation for each type.
- [Garage Door Won't Close? 10 Causes and How to Fix Each One](https://thegarage.guide/problems/garage-door-wont-close): Your garage door opens fine but won't close. Diagnose all 10 causes ranked easiest to hardest — sensors, limits, springs, gears, and more — with fix costs from $0 to $350.
- [Garage Door Won't Open: Diagnosis and Fix Guide](https://thegarage.guide/problems/garage-door-wont-open): Garage door won't open? Diagnose the cause in 60 seconds with this symptom-by-symptom guide. Broken springs, dead openers, frozen doors, and more.
- [Garage Floor Oil Stains: How to Remove Them for Good](https://thegarage.guide/problems/garage-floor-oil-stains): Remove garage floor oil stains with the right method for your stain's age. Fresh spills, set stains, and years-old patches all need different treatment. Step-by-step guide.
- [Water Leaking Into Garage: Causes, Fixes, and Prevention](https://thegarage.guide/problems/water-leaking-into-garage): Water in your garage can come from the door seal, floor cracks, walls, or poor drainage. Learn the 6 most common causes and how to fix each one permanently.
